title: MCP Calculation Tools
description: Tool definitions for the Math MCP Server compatible with Vercel AI SDK

tools.name: add
tools.description: Add two numbers together and return the sum. Use this when the user wants to add, sum, or combine numbers.

tools.name: subtract
tools.description: Subtract the second number from the first number. Use this when the user wants to subtract, minus, or find the difference between numbers.

tools.name: multiply
tools.description: Multiply two numbers together and return the product. Use this when the user wants to multiply, times, or find the product of numbers.

tools.name: divide
tools.description: Divide the first number by the second number. Use this when the user wants to divide, split, or find the quotient of numbers. Will return an error if dividing by zero.

b.description: The divisor (number to divide by, must not be zero)
